title: Phase-In of Large Care Point Increases — Assisted Living Residency and Care Agreement
content:
**Wellness Department billing note.** Under the Assisted Living Residency and Care Agreement a large care level increase is phased in. The phase-in is decided by the rise from the care points of the most recent routine reassessment to the care points the residency now carries.

| Rise in care points | Share of the difference billed for the days covered |
|---|---|
| 30 points or more | 0.5 |
| 15 points or more but under 30 | 0.75 |
| Under 15 points | Not phased |

The share is taken of the care fee difference for the days covered itself — the monthly difference divided by the days in the month, for each day covered — and the shared amount is what the charge bills for that difference; any amount subtracted from the charge is subtracted from that shared amount. The charge is rounded once to the cent at the end.

### Cases (hypothetical scores; most recent routine reassessment at 28 points)

| Care points the residency now carries | Rise | Share |
|---|---|---|
| 58 | 30 | 0.5 |
| 57 | 29 | 0.75 |
| 43 | 15 | 0.75 |
| 42 | 14 | Not phased |

Illustration: a difference of 392.666… for the days covered, with a rise of 33 points, is billed at 0.5 of it, 196.333…, before rounding.
